name: Fangda Special Steel Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Fangda Special Steel Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures, process, and sells ferrous metal smelting and related products in China. It operates through two segments, Special Steel Industry and Mining Industry. The company offers spring steel flat bars used in the automobile leaf spring and steering arm of air suspension; leaf spring; and hot-rolled steel bars, including ribbed bars, plate round bars, and resin anchoring bolt bars.
